population: One selected attempt per task from the 59 frozen Nanobot ZIPs.
method: At each native edit_file start, match earlier completed results by task, agent and normalized POSIX path (/app/ aliases are workspace-relative). Compare the literal nonempty old_text to the latest write_file call whose return confirms a successful write. Count non-overlapping occurrences. For read_file, strip line-number prefixes and join the visible lines with LF. Empty files and unchanged-file summaries do not supply numbered content. These comparisons do not establish model memory, complete current disk contents, or test results.
